$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFQW (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Vesoul - Frotey

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
Simultaneous use of RWY prohibited.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Paved RWY 08/26 prohibited for ACFT whose take-off distance reference greater than 800 m.
Unpaved RWY reserved for ULM.
Preferred QFU: 079°, due to noise pollution and West funnel.
With a NW or SW wind, heavy turbulences and wind shear at THR 26, allow a displaced LDG 350 m from THR.
Obstacles (trees) through lateral surfaces.
Reserved for pilots authorized by AD operator.
PCL on frequency 118.155 MHz, SKED 1500-0800 (SUM: - 1 HR).
Threshold and RWY end lights are made up of 2 side bars perpendicular to the threshold and RWY end.
Each side bar consists of 5 lights.
PJE (NR 232): see AIP ENR 5.5 Aerobatic activity (NR 6466): see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (NR 8051): see AIP ENR 5.5 Balloons activity: reserved for home based ACFT.
Occasional TKOF and as per as protocol.
Utilisation simultanée des pistes interdite.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
RWY revêtue 08/26 interdite aux aéronefs dont la distance de référence au décollage est supérieure à 800 m.
Piste non revêtue réservée aux ULM.
QFU 079° préférentiel cause nuisances et trouée Ouest.
Par vent de NW ou SW, fortes turbulences et cisaillement au seuil 26, prévoir un atterrissage décalé de 350 m du seuil.
Présence d'obstacles (arbres) dans les surfaces latérales.
Réservé aux pilotes autorisés par l'exploitant.
PCL sur fréquence 118.155 MHz, HOR 1500-0800.
Feux de seuils et d'extrémité de piste installés au droit du seuil et de l'extrémité en 2 barres de flanc.
Chaque barre de flanc est composée de 5 feux.
Activité parachutisme (N° 232) : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Activité voltige (N° 6466) : voir AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (N° 8051) : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Activité ballons : réservée aéronefs basés.
Décollages occasionnels et selon protocole.
